description.en: Tongue-shaped fossil leaves show a strong midrib and reticulate side veins.
description.zh: 舌形化石叶具有强中脉及网状侧脉。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Glossopteris, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Glossopteris 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Its netted vein topology could distinguish it from the Bjuvia strap leaf only if it survives as visible modeled relief; the shared entire elongate outline alone is insufficient.
distinctness.zh: 网状叶脉拓扑只有以可见几何浮雕保留时，才可能区别于Bjuvia带状叶；共有的全缘长叶外形本身不足以区分资产。

modeling_brief.en: Use a source-supported blade outline, central rib and restrained reticulate vein relief. Compare against Bjuvia under the same neutral material at the intended view; do not rely on painted veins or different scale.
modeling_brief.zh: 采用来源支持的叶缘、中脉及克制的网脉几何浮雕；在目标视距下用相同中性材质与Bjuvia对比，不依赖绘制叶脉或不同尺度。

assets.uncertainty: Leaf morphotaxon; precise canopy and reproductive attachment are not reconstructed. Lowpoly separation from Bjuvia remains unverified; no relief depth is claimed to be fossil-measured.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit. Audit #129 comparison gate: Glossopteris and Bjuvia share an entire elongate blade. Production is blocked until a side-by-side neutral-material test at the intended viewing distance demonstrates source-supported geometric distinction. Scale, colour, texture-only veins, pose, damage and taxonomic labels cannot establish separate assets. If relief is unreadable or requires unsupported exaggeration, consolidate or replace one concept before production.
